summary: Linear license inventory reconciliation, SCIM onboarding, and cost-center billing mapping
description:
Issue summary:
We need to reconcile current Linear (linear.app) seats across multiple orgs, enable SCIM provisioning via Okta, and ensure invoices are tagged to the correct cost centers before the next renewal window. Current seat counts appear inconsistent between the billing console and Okta group membership causing over-provisioning and unexpected charges.

Impact:
- Potential overspend estimated ~10-15% (~$6k/yr) if extra seats remain active.
- New hires and contractors are not reliably receiving licenses due to mismatched group sync rules.
- Risk of audit gaps for finance and security if billing tags are not aligned with GL codes.

Environment:
- Internal (orgs: redwood-core, redwood-ml, redwood-data)
- SSO provider: Okta (production tenant: redwood.okta.com)
- Staging domain for verification: staging-linear.redwood.internal
- Vendor product: Linear (SaaS), plan: Team + Audit add-on (current contract through 2026-05-31)

Steps to verify / reproduce the mismatch:
1) In Okta, inspect group "linear-team-active" membership and export members list (okta export attached).
2) In Linear billing console, export current seat assignments and seat history (linear export attached).
3) Compare emails and user IDs; note 23 users present in Linear billing but not in Okta group.
4) Query HR provisioning feed for terminated contractors in last 6 months and cross-reference.

Logs / Attachments:
- okta_linear_group_export_2026-02-28.csv (attached)
- linear_billing_export_2026-02-28.csv (attached)
- screenshot_linear_billing_page.png (attached)

Vendor contact:
- Elise Bertrand, Account Manager, Linear — elise@linear.app, +1-415-555-0182

Requested work and acceptance criteria:
A) Inventory and reconciliation (Due: 2026-03-18)
   - Produce a reconciled list mapping Okta users -> Linear user IDs -> Billing seat assignment.
   - Flag orphaned seats and identify whether they are contractors, service accounts, or duplicates.

B) SCIM onboarding and mapping (Due: 2026-03-25)
   - Enable SCIM provisioning in a sandbox/staging Linear org using redwood Okta test app.
   - Map Okta attributes: email, givenName, familyName, title, department, costCenter (custom).
   - Ensure deprovision action removes seat assignment in Linear after 30 minutes of Okta deactivation.
   - Provide runbook for Okta-to-Linear mapping and rollback steps.

C) Billing and cost-center mapping (Due: 2026-03-22)
   - Apply billing tags to active seats so invoices show CC-ENG-PLATFORM, CC-DATA, or CC-RESEARCH as appropriate.
   - Confirm vendor can emit a CSV of seat->cost-center for month-end reporting.

Approvals required:
- Finance: confirm GL mapping and PO limits (Finance owner: Priya Shah)
- Security: SCIM provisioning reviewed for provisioning scope and least privilege (Security owner: Ethan Park)
- Legal: confirm terms for automated deprovisioning (Legal owner: Hannah Lee)

Estimated cost and procurement ask:
- Asking to procure 60 seats for cross-org pooling until renewal: estimated $6,600/year (60 seats @ $110/seat/yr) + pro-rated credits for seats identified to be removed post-reconciliation.
- Preferred billing cadence: annual.

Rollback plan:
- If SCIM in staging causes unexpected removals, revert to manual sync and restore users from export snapshot within one hour.

Related links and references:
- Slack thread: #it-procurement (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C07XXXXXX/p1677622000000000)
- Confluence runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/IT/pages/13827/SCIM+provisioning+runbook
- Prior reimbursement ticket for seat reallocation: INT-67210

Notes:
- Requesting procurement to open PO and add Elise Bertrand as vendor contact in our vendor portal.
- Ask vendor to pause auto-renew until we confirm seat counts and cost-center mapping.
